name: v2_end_frame
edit_prompt: Edit only the paint on the palette: the three separate color blobs (orange, white, purple) are now fully mixed into one perfectly uniform flat color — a single solid pastel lavender, light muted pinkish-purple, completely even across the entire palette surface. No swirls, no streaks, no traces of original colors, no marble pattern, no color gradients. Flat smooth paint surface like fresh house paint. The palette knife is still resting on the paint surface, hand still holding it. Everything else unchanged — same palette, same hand position, same table, same lighting, same camera angle.
